value.rationale: This is the full embedded ideal census of the universal commutative short local algebra with maximal ideal cube zero, refined jointly by length and minimal number of generators; the latter governs embedding/top and is not determined by ideal dimension. It holds for arbitrary embedding dimension and finite characteristic, counts nonhomogeneous ideals, and yields precise principal/nonprincipal strata. The rank-three example in two variables has equal-dimensional principal and three-generated ideals. Unlike a small arithmetic patch, this is a complete natural invariant for a uniform infinite family, with potential benchmarking role for quotients.
